item.title: Good Morning Family - 26 August 2026
item.description:
Good morning Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Wednesday, the 26 August.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 6 degrees and a top of 15 degrees.
There is about a 2 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is D.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter D?
. . . . . . .
